--! id: aquarium
--! name: 蓝牙鱼缸
--! version: 3.8
--! desc: 墨水屏生态鱼塘，具名蓝牙访客、鱼档案、离线养成和繁育
--
-- 3.0 核心：状态由现实时间决定，而非运行时累积——
--   · 应用关闭期间世界照常运转：下次打开按 last_seen 推演饥饿/水草/水质/年龄
--   · 鱼有寿命（约 150~210 天）：疏于照顾饿出病鱼、连续 7 天无人照看才死亡；
--     死亡留墓碑与死因，语音键孵化下一代（继承 30% 经验）——世代传承 G1→G∞
--   · 生态：3 株水草按天生长（离线也长）、鱼饿急了啃草；投喂产生废物→水质下降
--     →缸壁长藻；微生物消化缓慢恢复水质；语音键长按换水；螺吃藻清洁
--   · 节律：晨游/午休/夜睡（夜里 BLE 访客只记录不投喂）——鱼跟着现实时间活
--   · 回归时的「离线报告」：离开多久、发生了什么
--
-- 串门协议 AQUM（2.0）：广播 AQUM|鱼名|等级，邻居鱼游入开宴席，单向无隐私
--
-- 3.3 界面与行为重制：
--   · 修复 ui.text 默认宽度是「左右对称留白」的语义坑——x>120 的文本宽度被压到
--     1px 逐字竖排折行（重叠根因）；全部多字符绘制显式传宽度
--   · 鱼的运动改为 boids-lite（参考 OpenGhost boids.py）：浮点坐标 + 转向力
--     （抢食/漫游锚点/边界回推/水流扰动）+ 阻尼限速；速度档随性格/节律/年龄变化
--   · 鱼形换为字库覆盖内的 ASCII 鱼 >＜（（（o> 系（※■＠◇＜＞○† 均缺字形）
--   · 饱食度 4 格半格制右对齐（ui.measure 防重叠）；浑浊用第二层波浪避让 banner；
--     饲料上限 24 颗防洪泛刷屏；日志截断改按 UTF-8 字符边界（防腰斩非法字节）
--
-- 3.4 真机启动超时修复：
--   · 固件 store.set 每次都是「读全量 → 更新 → 全量 AES 加密重写文件」，真机实测
--     数百 ms/次——顶层离线推演后连写 7 个 key 必超 3 秒（main.lua:1262 报错的根因）
--   · feed 类计数（fed_count/today_fed/manual_count/manual_day）合并为单 key "feed"，
--     日切从 3 次写降为 1 次；last_seen 并入 sim 序列化尾部字段
--   · flush_store 改限流写：每次回调最多写 limit 个 key（默认 3），剩余脏项由
--     on_idle 每 5 帧逐个消化；写入顺序即重要性（sim > feed > log > 名录 > 已见），
--     被限流丢弃的只是尾部统计，养成状态绝不丢

-- ---------- 常量 ----------
local COLS = 30
local TZ = 28800
local FEED_RSSI = -75
local REVISIT_COOLDOWN = 600
local REVISIT_LUCK = 0.3
local HUNGER_FRAMES = 240          -- 在场饥饿步长（约 3 分钟 +1）
local HUNGER_MAX = 8
local GUEST_COOLDOWN = 600
local MANUAL_DAILY = 3
local SICK_DAYS = 2                -- 饿满后进入病鱼的离线天数
local DEAD_DAYS = 7                -- 连续无人照看致死的天数
local WATER_X2_MAX = 10            -- 水质（×2 整数，5.0 满分）
local GRASS_MAX = 5                -- 水草最大节数
local LEVELS = {0, 3, 8, 15, 25, 40, 60, 90, 130, 180, 240}
local STAGES = {"鱼卵", "鱼苗", "幼鱼", "成鱼", "壮年", "老年"}
local TEMPERS = {"慢吞吞", "活泼", "贪吃"}

-- ---------- store 基础 ----------
local RESET_KEYS = {
    "seed", "fish_name", "first_day", "sim", "feed", "badges", "breed", "breed_used",
    "child", "calm", "named_seen", "named_total", "friends", "friends_tail", "log",
    "seen", "seen_total", "fed_count", "today_fed", "manual_count", "manual_day", "last_seen",
}

local start_tank

local function draw_reset_page(lines, hint, full)
    if ui.immersive then ui.immersive(false) end
    ui.clear()
    ui.title("开发重置")
    local w = ui.size()
    local top, lh = ui.content_top(), ui.line_height()
    for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
        ui.text(line, 24, top + i * (lh + 8), w - 48)
    end
    ui.footer(hint)
    if full then ui.flush(true) end
end

local function begin_reset()
    local index = 1
    local done = false
    local full = true
    local last_progress = 0
    if ble.scan_active() then ble.scan_stop() end
    if ble.adv_active() then ble.adv_stop() end
    -- 重置期间接管回调，防止旧内存状态被重新写回；中断后从头续做。
    function draw()
        local lines = done and {"重置完成", "长按左键开新鱼塘"}
            or {"正在清空鱼塘记录", (index - 1) .. " / " .. #RESET_KEYS}
        draw_reset_page(lines, done and "长左 返回鱼塘" or "请稍候", full)
        full = false
    end
    function on_key(action)
        if done and action == "prev_long" then start_tank() end
    end
    function on_idle()
        if done then return false end
        -- 固件每次 store.set 都会加密重写整份存档，每个节拍最多写一次。
        while index <= #RESET_KEYS do
            local key = RESET_KEYS[index]
            index = index + 1
            if (store.get(key) or "") ~= "" then
                store.set(key, "")
                if index - last_progress < 4 then return false end
                last_progress = index
                return true
            end
        end
        store.set("reset_pending", "")
        done = true
        full = true
        return true
    end
end

-- 开缸初始化也供重置完成后使用，避免旧回调把清空前的鱼塘写回存档。
start_tank = function()
local function load_num(key, dflt)
    return tonumber(store.get(key) or "") or dflt
end

local seed = load_num("seed", 0)
if seed == 0 then
    seed = math.random(1000, 9999)
    store.set("seed", tostring(seed))
end
math.randomseed(seed)

local fish_name = store.get("fish_name")
if fish_name == nil or fish_name == "" then
    fish_name = "墨墨" .. (seed % 100)
    store.set("fish_name", fish_name)
end
local temper = seed % 3
local lifespan = 150 + seed % 61   -- 自然寿命 150~210 天（照顾质量另有影响）

-- 旧计数混有匿名 MAC，无法还原具名访客数；养成记录沿用原键。
local seen_total = load_num("named_total", 0)
local first_day = load_num("first_day", 0)

-- feed 类计数合并单 key "feed"（fed|today|manual|mdy）：投喂/日切从 3~4 次写盘降为 1 次。
-- 旧版散 key 兼容读取（升级首启读旧值，此后只写新 key）
local fed_count, today_fed, manual_count, manual_day = 0, 0, 0, 0
do
    local raw = store.get("feed") or ""
    local p = {}
    for v in (raw .. "|"):gmatch("([^|]*)|") do p[#p + 1] = v end
    if p[1] and p[1] ~= "" then
        fed_count = tonumber(p[1]) or 0
        today_fed = tonumber(p[2]) or 0
        manual_count = tonumber(p[3]) or 0
        manual_day = tonumber(p[4]) or 0
    else
        fed_count = load_num("fed_count", 0)
        today_fed = load_num("today_fed", 0)
        manual_count = load_num("manual_count", 0)
        manual_day = load_num("manual_day", 0)
    end
end

local feed_dirty = false
local function save_feed() feed_dirty = true end   -- 落盘交给 flush_store 限流写

-- 家族与个体（sim 状态紧凑序列化，单 key）
-- 格式：h1,h2,h3|waterX2|algae|snailActive|snailX|bornDay|gen|legacyExp|deadFlag|deathCause|lifespan|sickSince|lastSeen
-- lastSeen 并入 sim（3.4）：离线推演基准随缸体状态一次写盘，不再单独 store.set
local sim = { grass = {2, 1, 3}, waterX2 = 8, algae = 0, snail = 0, snail_on = 0,
              born_day = 0, gen = 1, legacy = 0, dead = 0, cause = "",
              lifespan = lifespan, sick_day = 0, last_seen = 0 }
do
    local raw = store.get("sim") or ""
    local p = {}
    for v in (raw .. "|"):gmatch("([^|]*)|") do p[#p + 1] = v end
    if p[1] and p[1] ~= "" then
        local i = 1
        for h in p[1]:gmatch("[^,]+") do
            if sim.grass[i] ~= nil then sim.grass[i] = tonumber(h) or sim.grass[i] end
            i = i + 1
        end
        sim.waterX2 = tonumber(p[2]) or sim.waterX2
        sim.algae = tonumber(p[3]) or sim.algae
        sim.snail_on = tonumber(p[4]) or sim.snail_on
        sim.snail = tonumber(p[5]) or sim.snail
        sim.born_day = tonumber(p[6]) or sim.born_day
        sim.gen = tonumber(p[7]) or sim.gen
        sim.legacy = tonumber(p[8]) or sim.legacy
        sim.dead = tonumber(p[9]) or sim.dead
        sim.cause = p[10] or ""
        sim.lifespan = tonumber(p[11]) or sim.lifespan
        sim.sick_day = tonumber(p[12]) or sim.sick_day
        -- 3.3 及更早记录无第 13 字段：回退读独立的 last_seen key（3.3 只写不删）
        sim.last_seen = tonumber(p[13]) or load_num("last_seen", 0)
    else
        sim.last_seen = load_num("last_seen", 0)
    end
end
if sim.born_day == 0 then sim.born_day = -1 end   -- -1 = 尚未初始化（顶层赋值）

-- 真机写盘成本高（每次 store.set = 全量序列化 + AES 加密 + SPI flash 写），
-- BLE 环境下单轮可能涌入几十台设备，任何逐台写盘都会让单次回调超 3 秒上限。
-- 因此 sim/social/feed 三类状态全部「内存修改 + 脏标记」，由 flush_store() 统一落盘
local sim_dirty = false

local function save_sim()
    sim_dirty = true   -- 兼容全部历史调用点：置脏，落盘交给 flush_store
end

local function sim_serial()
    -- 字段顺序必须与解析端完全一致：草×3,水质,藻,螺开关,螺位,生日,世代,继承,死亡,死因,寿命,病危日,末次在场
    return string.format("%d,%d,%d|%d|%d|%d|%d|%d|%d|%d|%d|%s|%d|%d|%d",
        sim.grass[1], sim.grass[2], sim.grass[3], sim.waterX2, sim.algae,
        sim.snail_on, sim.snail, sim.born_day, sim.gen, sim.legacy,
        sim.dead, sim.cause, sim.lifespan, sim.sick_day, sim.last_seen)
end

-- 水质显示：×2 整数 → "4.0"/"2.5" 这样的半点格式
local function water_str()
    return string.format("%d.%d", math.floor(sim.waterX2 / 2), sim.waterX2 % 2 * 5)
end

local badges = store.get("badges") or ""

-- ---------- 时间工具 ----------
local function wall_time()
    return tonumber(sys.time() or 0) + TZ
end
local function day_of(t)
    return math.floor(t / 86400)
end
local function hhmm(t)
    local d = t % 86400
    return string.format("%02d%02d", math.floor(d / 3600), math.floor(d % 3600 / 60))
end
local function hour_of(t)
    return math.floor(t % 86400 / 3600)
end
local function is_night(t)
    local h = hour_of(t)
    return h >= 20 or h < 6
end
local function is_sleeping(t)
    -- 夜睡更严格：22 点 ~ 5 点
    local h = hour_of(t)
    return h >= 22 or h < 5
end
if first_day == 0 then
    first_day = day_of(wall_time())
    store.set("first_day", tostring(first_day))
end
if manual_day ~= day_of(wall_time()) then
    manual_day = day_of(wall_time())
    manual_count = 0
    today_fed = 0
    save_feed()   -- 3.3 及更早：此处 3 次 store.set（跨日首启叠加推演写盘必超时）
end

-- ---------- 动画状态（提前声明） ----------
local frame = 0
local hunger = 4
-- 鱼的运动学状态（boids-lite，参考 OpenGhost boids.py 的「转向力→限速→边界回推」）：
-- x/y 为浮点列/行坐标（y ∈ 0..4，渲染行 = y+5），vx/vy 为每帧位移，wx/wy 为漫游锚点
local fish = { x = 6, y = 2, vx = 0.8, vy = 0, dir = 1, wx = 20, wy = 2, wt = 0 }
local bubbles = { { x = 9, y = 2 }, { x = 14, y = 1 }, { x = 19, y = 3 } }
local view = "tank"
local menu_index = 1
local log_page, log_pages = 1, 1
local log_parent = "menu"
local calm = load_num("calm", 0) == 1
local matrix_frames = 0
local feeds = {}
local guest = nil
local last_guest_at = 0
local last_rssi = -100
local mac_cooldown = {}
local awake = true           -- 本帧是否清醒（节律）

-- ---------- 繁育状态（3.1）：每鱼一生一次，每缸最多一个子女 ----------
local breed_on = load_num("breed", 0) == 1        -- 繁育开关（默认关，避免误消耗）
local breed_used = load_num("breed_used", 0) == 1 -- 本鱼繁育权是否已用
local child = nil                                 -- 缸内唯一子女
do
    local raw = store.get("child") or ""
    if raw ~= "" then
        local p = {}
        for v in (raw .. "|"):gmatch("([^|]*)|") do p[#p + 1] = v end
        if p[1] and p[1] ~= "" then
            child = { name = p[1], gen = tonumber(p[2]) or 1, exp = tonumber(p[3]) or 0,
                      born = tonumber(p[4]) or 0, lifespan = tonumber(p[5]) or 180,
                      parent = p[6] or "" }
        end
    end
end
local child_fish = { x = 20, y = 1, dir = -1 }
local mate_code = math.random(0x1000, 0xFFFF)     -- 本轮求偶码（每次启动重生成）
local transfer_until = 0                          -- 转移模式截止时间（0=未转移）
local transfer_id = nil                           -- 本次转移码（2 位十六进制）
local transfer_seq = 1
local transfer_rx = {}                            -- 接收缓存：id -> { total, parts }
local transfer_confirm = nil                      -- 接收完成后回告：{ id, until }
local mate_confirm = nil                          -- 诞生后回告配对：{ mine, peer, until }

local function visitor_name(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end
    name = name:gsub("[%c;|]", " "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    local lower = name:lower()
    if lower == "" or lower == "unknown" or lower == "anonymous"
        or name == "匿名" or name == "匿名设备" or name == "未知设备" then return nil end
    return name
end

-- ---------- 日志 / 名录 / 成就 ----------
local logs = {}
do
    local raw = store.get("log") or ""
    for item in raw:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        if not item:match("友 匿名%s+%-?%d+$") then logs[#logs + 1] = item end
    end
end
local MAX_FRIENDS = 10
local friends = {}
do
    local loaded = {}
    local raw = (store.get("friends") or "") .. ";" .. (store.get("friends_tail") or "")
    for item in raw:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local fname, cnt = item:match("(.+)|(%d+)$")
        fname = visitor_name(fname)
        if fname and utf8.len(fname) and not loaded[fname] and #friends < MAX_FRIENDS then
            friends[#friends + 1] = { name = fname, count = tonumber(cnt) or 1 }
            loaded[fname] = true
        end
    end
end
-- ---------- 日志与常客（内存为主，脏标记批量落盘） ----------
-- 真机一次 BLE 扫描可能涌入几十台新设备：逐台 store.set 会触发几十次全量加密写盘，
-- 单次回调必超 3 秒上限。改为内存修改 + 脏标记，每轮统一落盘一次（写盘次数恒定）
local log_dirty, friends_dirty, friends_tail_dirty, seen_dirty, total_dirty, badges_dirty

local function push_log(text)
    logs[#logs + 1] = hhmm(wall_time()) .. " " .. text
    while #logs > 10 do table.remove(logs, 1) end
    log_dirty = true
end

-- 已见设备集合：单 key LRU（≤15 台，约 195B ≤ value 上限 200B），
-- 被淘汰的设备回来会再次投喂一次（有内存冷却表防连击，语义上「新朋友」本就带随机性）
local seen_list = {}   -- MAC 数组（最新在尾部）
local seen_index = {}  -- mac -> 数组下标
do
    local raw = store.get("named_seen") or ""
    for mac in raw:gmatch("[0-9a-f]+") do
        seen_list[#seen_list + 1] = mac
        seen_index[mac] = #seen_list
    end
end

local function seen_has(mac)
    if not mac then return false end
    return seen_index[mac] ~= nil
end

local function seen_add(mac)
    if not mac or #mac > 20 then return end
    if seen_index[mac] ~= nil then return end
    seen_list[#seen_list + 1] = mac
    seen_index[mac] = #seen_list
    while #seen_list > 15 do
        local oldest = table.remove(seen_list, 1)
        seen_index[oldest] = nil
        -- 重建下标：remove 后其余元素前移
        for i, m in ipairs(seen_list) do seen_index[m] = i end
    end
    seen_dirty = true
end

local function touch_friend(name)
    for _, f in ipairs(friends) do
        if f.name == name then
            f.count = f.count + 1
            friends_dirty = true
            return
        end
    end
    friends[#friends + 1] = { name = name, count = 1 }
    while #friends > MAX_FRIENDS do table.remove(friends, 1) end
    friends_dirty, friends_tail_dirty = true, true
end

-- 脏数据统一落盘：flush_store 按重要性限流写（feed 组计数已并入单 key，见文件头部）

-- 按 store 值上限（200B）截断字符串；纯字节截断会把多字节 UTF-8 字符腰斩，
-- 写出非法字节序列（真机 JSON 序列化同样会炸），故回退到字符边界
local function utf8_clip(s, max)
    if #s <= max then return s end
    local cut = max + 1   -- 排他结束位：sub(1, cut-1)
    while cut > 1 and s:byte(cut) >= 0x80 and s:byte(cut) < 0xC0 do
        cut = cut - 1     -- 落在延续字节上，回退到字符起点
    end
    return s:sub(1, cut - 1)
end

-- 现场持续进访客时轮转写盘，单次回调仍受原有预算限制。
local save_cursor = 1
local STORE_KEYS = {"sim", "feed", "badges", "named_seen", "named_total", "friends", "friends_tail", "log"}
local function flush_store(limit, priority)
    if priority then save_cursor = 1 end
    for _ = 1, #STORE_KEYS do
        local key = STORE_KEYS[save_cursor]
        save_cursor = save_cursor % #STORE_KEYS + 1
        local value
        if key == "sim" and sim_dirty then
            value, sim_dirty = sim_serial(), false
        elseif key == "feed" and feed_dirty then
            value = string.format("%d|%d|%d|%d", fed_count, today_fed, manual_count, manual_day)
            feed_dirty = false
        elseif key == "badges" and badges_dirty then
            value, badges_dirty = badges, false
        elseif key == "named_total" and total_dirty then
            value, total_dirty = tostring(seen_total), false
        elseif key == "named_seen" and seen_dirty then
            value, seen_dirty = table.concat(seen_list, ","), false
        elseif (key == "friends" and friends_dirty) or (key == "friends_tail" and friends_tail_dirty) then
            -- 每个分片最多五个名字，满足单个存储值的 200 字节限制。
            local first = key == "friends" and 1 or 6
            local rows = {}
            for i = first, math.min(first + 4, #friends) do
                local f = friends[i]
                rows[#rows + 1] = utf8_clip(f.name, 24) .. "|" .. f.count
            end
            value = table.concat(rows, ";")
            if key == "friends" then friends_dirty = false else friends_tail_dirty = false end
        elseif key == "log" and log_dirty then
            value, log_dirty = utf8_clip(table.concat(logs, ";"), 200), false
        end
        if value then
            store.set(key, value)
            limit = limit - 1
            if limit == 0 then return end
        end
    end
end
local function grant_badge(id)
    if badges:find(id, 1, true) then return end
    badges = badges .. id
    badges_dirty = true
    push_log("成就解锁 [" .. id .. "]")
end

-- ---------- 成长与年龄 ----------
local exp_fed = fed_count
local function level_of(e)
    for lv = #LEVELS, 1, -1 do
        if e >= LEVELS[lv] then return lv end
    end
    return 1
end
local lv = level_of(exp_fed + sim.legacy)   -- 继承经验计入等级
local function age_days(now)
    if sim.born_day <= 0 then return 0 end
    return day_of(now) - sim.born_day
end
-- 年龄阶段：卵 0 / 鱼苗 1 / 幼鱼 2 / 成鱼 3 / 壮年 4 / 老年 5
local function stage_of(age)
    if age < 1 then return 0 end
    if age < 7 then return 1 end
    if age < 30 then return 2 end
    if age < 90 then return 3 end
    if age < sim.lifespan - 30 then return 4 end
    return 5
end

-- ---------- 广播：AQUM 串门 / AQUB 繁育 / AQUT 转移（同一 AD 结构轮播） ----------
local advertised_body
local function adv_raw(body)
    body = body:sub(1, 28)
    if body == advertised_body and ble.adv_active() then return end
    ble.adv_stop()
    advertised_body = ble.adv_start(string.char(#body + 1, 0x09) .. body, 100, 2) and body or nil
end

-- 是否具备繁育条件：开关开、本鱼有繁育权、缸内无子女、在世且成年、未在转移
local function can_breed(t)
    if not breed_on or breed_used or child ~= nil or sim.dead == 1 then return false end
    if transfer_until > t then return false end
    return stage_of(age_days(t)) >= 3
end

-- 子女记录序列化：本地存储与分片广播共用同一格式
local function child_serial()
    if child == nil then return "" end
    return string.format("%s|%d|%d|%d|%d|%s", child.name, child.gen, child.exp,
        child.born, child.lifespan, child.parent)
end

local function save_child() store.set("child", child and child_serial():sub(1, 190) or "") end

local function advertise(force)
    -- 协议帧按原节拍轮换；普通串门广播由 adv_raw 去重。
    if not force and frame % 3 ~= 0 then return end
    if not ble.running() then return end
    local t = wall_time()
    if transfer_until > t and child ~= nil then
        -- 转移模式：分片轮播，每片带序号与总数
        local data = child_serial()
        local total = math.max(1, math.ceil(#data / 16))
        local seq = (transfer_seq - 1) % total + 1
        adv_raw(string.format("AQUT|%s|%d|%d|%s", transfer_id, seq, total,
            data:sub((seq - 1) * 16 + 1, seq * 16)))
        transfer_seq = seq + 1
        return
    end
    if transfer_confirm ~= nil then
        if t < transfer_confirm.deadline then
            adv_raw("AQUB|C|" .. transfer_confirm.id)   -- 已收下子女，回告来源方
            return
        end
        transfer_confirm = nil
    end
    if mate_confirm ~= nil then
        if t < mate_confirm.deadline then
            adv_raw(string.format("AQUB|M|%04X|%04X", mate_confirm.mine, mate_confirm.peer))
            return
        end
        mate_confirm = nil
    end
    if can_breed(t) and frame % 6 == 0 then
        adv_raw(string.format("AQUB|Q|%04X|G%d|L%d", mate_code, sim.gen, lv))
        return
    end
    adv_raw(string.format("AQUM|%s|L%d", fish_name, lv))
end

local function classify(name)
    if name:find("iPhone") or name:find("MI ") or name:find("Mac") or name:find("HUAWEI")
        or name:find("HONOR") then return "phone" end
    if name:find("and") or name:find("Band") or name:find("手环") then return "band" end
    if name:find("Pods") or name:find("Ear") or name:find("Free") then return "ear" end
    return "other"
end
local FOOD = { phone = "*", band = "%", ear = "@", other = "." }

-- ---------- 繁育：求偶码仲裁 ----------
-- 双方都在广播求偶码时，码小的一方诞生子女；同一对鱼双方判断一致，
-- 因此数学上只会诞生一个子女（码相同概率 1/65536，直接跳过）。
-- 取首个完整 UTF-8 字符（避免按字节截断汉字产生乱码）
local function first_char(s)
    local b = s:byte(1)
    if b == nil then return "" end
    if b < 0x80 then return s:sub(1, 1) end
    local n = 2
    if b >= 0xF0 then n = 4 elseif b >= 0xE0 then n = 3 end
    return s:sub(1, n)
end

-- 按 UTF-8 边界截断（超过上限时不切断汉字）
local function utf8_cut(s, max_bytes)
    if #s <= max_bytes then return s end
    local i = max_bytes
    while i > 0 do
        local b = s:byte(i + 1)
        if b == nil or b < 0x80 or b >= 0xC0 then return s:sub(1, i) end
        i = i - 1
    end
    return ""
end

local function birth_child(t, peer_gen, peer_lv, peer_code)
    if child ~= nil then return end
    local cname = first_char(fish_name) .. "小" .. tostring(math.random(10, 99))
    local inherit = math.floor((exp_fed + (LEVELS[peer_lv] or 0)) * 0.15)
    child = {
        name = cname,
        gen = math.max(sim.gen, peer_gen) + 1,
        exp = inherit,
        born = day_of(t),
        lifespan = 150 + (seed + math.random(0, 60)) % 61,
        parent = (utf8_cut(fish_name, 12) .. "*L" .. peer_lv),
    }
    child_fish.x = 18
    child_fish.dir = -1
    save_child()
    breed_used = true
    store.set("breed_used", "1")
    mate_confirm = { mine = mate_code, peer = tonumber(peer_code, 16) or 0, deadline = t + 30 }
    push_log("繁育成功：" .. cname .. " G" .. child.gen)
    grant_badge("繁衍")
end

-- 收到求偶帧：码小者诞生子女并回告；码大者等对方回告后再消耗繁育权
local function on_breed_offer(t, code, peer_gen, peer_lv)
    if not can_breed(t) then return end
    local peer = tonumber(code, 16)
    if peer == nil or peer == mate_code then return end
    if mate_code < peer then birth_child(t, peer_gen, peer_lv, code) end
end

-- 收到配对回告：对方（码小）已诞生子女，本机消耗繁育权
local function on_breed_mate(t, mine)
    if child ~= nil or breed_used then return end
    if mine ~= string.format("%04X", mate_code) then return end   -- 不是指名给我
    breed_used = true
    store.set("breed_used", "1")
    push_log("配对成功，子女养在邻居缸中")
    grant_badge("繁衍")
end

-- 收到子女分片：收齐即在本缸建立（本缸已有子女则拒绝）
local function on_transfer_part(t, id, seq, total, part)
    local slot = transfer_rx[id]
    if slot == nil then
        slot = { total = total, parts = {} }
        transfer_rx[id] = slot
    end
    if slot.total ~= total then return end
    slot.parts[seq] = part
    for i = 1, total do
        if slot.parts[i] == nil then return end
    end
    local data = table.concat(slot.parts, "")
    transfer_rx[id] = nil
    if child ~= nil then
        push_log("收到邻居子女，但缸内已有一条")
        return
    end
    local p = {}
    for v in (data .. "|"):gmatch("([^|]*)|") do p[#p + 1] = v end
    if not p[1] or p[1] == "" then return end
    child = { name = utf8_cut(p[1], 12), gen = tonumber(p[2]) or 1,
              exp = tonumber(p[3]) or 0,
              born = tonumber(p[4]) or day_of(t), lifespan = tonumber(p[5]) or 180,
              parent = utf8_cut(p[6] or "", 16) }
    child_fish.x = 18
    child_fish.dir = -1
    save_child()
    transfer_confirm = { id = id, deadline = t + 30 }
    push_log("邻居的小鱼 " .. child.name .. " 游进了缸里")
    grant_badge("寄养")
end

local function handle_scan()
    if not ble.scan_active() then return end
    local t = wall_time()
    local asleep = is_sleeping(t)
    local found = ble.scan_get()
    last_rssi = -100
    for _, dev in ipairs(found) do
        local raw = dev.name or ""
        local prefix = raw:sub(1, 5)
        if prefix == "AQUM|" then
            local gname, glv = dev.name:match("^AQUM|(.+)|L(%d+)$")
            if gname and gname ~= fish_name and t - last_guest_at >= GUEST_COOLDOWN
                and guest == nil and not asleep then
                gname = utf8_cut(gname, 12)
                guest = { name = gname, lv = tonumber(glv) or 1, frames = 16 }
                last_guest_at = t
                push_log("邻居 " .. gname .. "(Lv" .. (glv or "?") .. ") 来串门")
                touch_friend(gname)
                feed("@")
                feed("@")
            end
        elseif prefix == "AQUB|" then
            -- 繁育帧：Q 求偶 / M 配对回告 / C 转移确认
            local qcode, qgen, qlv = dev.name:match("^AQUB|Q|(%x+)|G(%d+)|L(%d+)$")
            local mime = dev.name:match("^AQUB|M|(%x+)|(%x+)$")
            local cid = dev.name:match("^AQUB|C|(%x+)$")
            if qcode then
                on_breed_offer(t, qcode, tonumber(qgen) or 1, tonumber(qlv) or 1)
            elseif mime then
                on_breed_mate(t, mime)
            elseif cid and transfer_id ~= nil and cid == transfer_id and child ~= nil then
                -- 邻居已收下子女，本缸立即完成迁移（不必等超时）
                child = nil
                save_child()
                transfer_until = 0
                push_log("子女已经迁往邻居缸中")
            end
        elseif prefix == "AQUT|" then
            local tid, seq, total, part = dev.name:match("^AQUT|(%x+)|(%d+)|(%d+)|(.*)$")
            if tid and seq and total and part then
                on_transfer_part(t, tid, tonumber(seq), tonumber(total), part)
            end
        elseif raw ~= "" then
            local name = visitor_name(raw)
            local mac = (dev.mac or ""):gsub(":", "")
            if name and #mac == 12 and mac:match("^%x+$") and utf8.len(name) then
                name = utf8_clip(name, 24)
                last_rssi = math.max(last_rssi, dev.rssi)
                local kind = classify(name)
                if not seen_has(mac) then
                    seen_add(mac)
                    seen_total = seen_total + 1
                    total_dirty = true
                    feed(FOOD[kind])
                    push_log("新朋友 " .. name .. " " .. dev.rssi)
                    touch_friend(name)
                    if seen_total >= 3 and sim.snail_on == 0 then
                        sim.snail_on = 1
                        push_log("一只螺住进了缸里")
                        save_sim()
                    end
                else
                    local last = mac_cooldown[dev.mac]
                    if not asleep and dev.rssi >= FEED_RSSI
                        and t - (last or 0) >= REVISIT_COOLDOWN
                        and math.random() < REVISIT_LUCK then
                        mac_cooldown[dev.mac] = t
                        feed(FOOD[kind])
                        push_log("老友 " .. name .. " " .. dev.rssi)
                        touch_friend(name)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ---------- 离线推演（真实性引擎）：状态 = f(现实时间) ----------
local report_lines = {}
local function offline_tick(now)
    local last = sim.last_seen
    if last <= 0 then last = now end   -- 首启：无历史基准，从当前时刻开始
    local delta = now - last
    if delta < 3600 then
        if sim.born_day == -1 then
            sim.born_day = day_of(now)
            save_sim()
            push_log("开缸：" .. fish_name .. " G" .. sim.gen)
        end
        return
    end
    local hours = math.floor(delta / 3600)
    local days = math.floor(delta / 86400)    report_lines[#report_lines + 1] = "你离开了 " .. (days > 0 and (days .. " 天 ") or "")
        .. (hours % 24) .. " 小时"

    if sim.dead ~= 1 then
        -- 饥饿：离线 +1/小时（8 格封顶）；饿满天数累计，SICK_DAYS 病、DEAD_DAYS 死
        hunger = math.min(HUNGER_MAX, hunger + hours)
        if hunger >= HUNGER_MAX then
            local away_days = math.floor(hours / 24)
            if away_days >= DEAD_DAYS then
                die("连续 " .. away_days .. " 天无人照看")
            elseif away_days >= SICK_DAYS then
                sim.sick_day = day_of(now)
                push_log("鱼饿病了，浮在水面（快喂食！）")
                report_lines[#report_lines + 1] = "鱼饿病了，需要立刻喂食"
            end
        end
        -- 水草：离线照长（封顶）；水质差会枯
        if days > 0 then
            for i = 1, 3 do
                sim.grass[i] = math.min(GRASS_MAX, sim.grass[i] + days)
            end
            if days > 0 then report_lines[#report_lines + 1] = "水草长了 " .. days .. " 节" end
        end
        -- 水质：微生物每 12 小时消化 +0.5，但鱼粪累积整体偏降
        sim.waterX2 = math.max(0, sim.waterX2 - math.min(6, math.floor(hours / 6)))
        if days > 0 and sim.waterX2 <= 2 then
            sim.algae = math.min(4, sim.algae + 1)
            report_lines[#report_lines + 1] = "水质下降，缸壁长出了藻"
        end
        -- 年老：跨过寿命上限自然死亡
        local age = age_days(now)
        if age >= sim.lifespan then
            die("年老（享年 " .. age .. " 天）")
            report_lines[#report_lines + 1] = "鱼已经老去…（语音键孵化下一代）"
        end
    end
    -- 螺：离线缓慢爬行
    if sim.snail_on == 1 then
        sim.snail = (sim.snail + days * 3 + hours) % COLS
    end
    if #report_lines > 0 then
        view = "report"
        push_log("离线 " .. days .. " 天 " .. (hours % 24) .. " 小时后回归")
    end
end

-- ---------- 在场生态推进 ----------
local function step()
    frame = frame + 1
    local t = wall_time()
    awake = not is_sleeping(t)

    if sim.dead == 1 then return end

    -- 邻居离场
    if guest ~= nil then
        guest.frames = guest.frames - 1
        if guest.frames <= 0 then
            push_log("邻居 " .. guest.name .. " 游回自家鱼缸")
            guest = nil
        end
    end

    -- 鱼的运动（boids-lite，参考 OpenGhost boids.py：转向力 → 阻尼限速 → 边界回推）
    -- 速度上限由性格/RSSI/节律/年龄/饥饿决定；平时游向随机锚点，有食物时抢食
    local age = age_days(t)
    local stage = stage_of(age)
    local sick = sim.sick_day > 0 and sim.dead ~= 1   -- 病鱼浮在水面不动
    local limit = temper == 0 and 0.65 or 0.9         -- 每次墨水屏刷新只游一小段
    if last_rssi >= -60 then limit = limit + 0.2 end
    local h = hour_of(t)
    if h >= 6 and h < 8 then limit = limit + 0.2 end
    if h >= 12 and h < 14 then limit = limit * 0.8 end
    if stage >= 5 or hunger >= HUNGER_MAX then limit = math.min(limit, 0.6) end
    if calm or not awake then limit = limit * 0.55 end

    -- 漫游锚点：每 24~48 帧挑一个新目标点（代替 boids 的聚集力）
    fish.wt = fish.wt - 1
    if fish.wt <= 0 then
        fish.wx = 2 + math.random() * (COLS - 12)
        fish.wy = math.random(0, 4)
        fish.wt = 24 + math.random(24)
    end

    -- 最近饲料（抢食目标）
    local nearest = nil
    local nd = 1e9
    for _, f in ipairs(feeds) do
        local dist = math.abs(f.x - fish.x) + math.abs(f.y - 5 - fish.y)
        if dist < nd then nearest = f; nd = dist end
    end

    -- 转向力合成：抢食 > 锚点 > 边界回推 > 水流扰动
    local ax, ay = 0, 0
    if nearest ~= nil and not sick then
        ax = ax + (nearest.x - fish.x) * 0.25
        ay = ay + (nearest.y - 5 - fish.y) * 0.25
    else
        ax = ax + (fish.wx - fish.x) * 0.04
        ay = ay + (fish.wy - fish.y) * 0.04
    end
    -- 活动边界按体型收缩：大鱼体长（lv≥9 达 10 格）提前回转，避免撞缸壁导致 art 折行
    local x_max = COLS - 9
    if lv >= 9 then x_max = COLS - 18 elseif lv >= 4 then x_max = COLS - 13 end
    if fish.x < 2 then ax = ax + (2 - fish.x) * 0.2 end
    if fish.x > x_max then ax = ax - (fish.x - x_max) * 0.2 end
    if fish.y < 0 then ay = ay - fish.y * 0.15 end
    if fish.y > 4 then ay = ay - (fish.y - 4) * 0.15 end
    ax = ax + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15   -- 水流扰动：轨迹不做直线
    ay = ay + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
    fish.vx = fish.vx * 0.95 + ax
    fish.vy = fish.vy * 0.9 + ay
    local speed_sq = fish.vx * fish.vx + fish.vy * fish.vy
    if speed_sq > limit * limit then
        local scale = limit / math.sqrt(speed_sq)
        fish.vx = fish.vx * scale
        fish.vy = fish.vy * scale
    end
    if sick then fish.vx, fish.vy = 0, 0 end
    fish.x = math.min(x_max, math.max(0, fish.x + fish.vx))
    fish.y = math.min(4, math.max(0, fish.y + fish.vy))
    if fish.vx > 0.15 then fish.dir = 1 elseif fish.vx < -0.15 then fish.dir = -1 end

    -- 子女：两帧一步。抢食时冲向食物（落后主鱼）、平时一半跟着主鱼（聚集）、一半自主漫游
    if child ~= nil and frame % 2 == 0 and sim.dead ~= 1 then
        local tx, ty
        if nearest ~= nil then
            tx, ty = math.max(1, nearest.x - 3), math.min(3, math.max(0, nearest.y - 6))
        elseif math.random() < 0.5 then
            tx, ty = math.max(1, fish.x - 4), fish.y
        else
            tx, ty = math.random(1, COLS - 10), math.random(0, 3)
        end
        local dx, dy = tx - child_fish.x, ty - child_fish.y
        child_fish.x = child_fish.x + math.max(-1, math.min(1, dx * 0.3))
        child_fish.y = child_fish.y + math.max(-0.5, math.min(0.5, dy * 0.3))
        if dx > 0.5 then child_fish.dir = 1 elseif dx < -0.5 then child_fish.dir = -1 end
    end

    -- 气泡：夜睡变小、水质差变少；新泡从鱼嘴附近冒出
    if awake and sim.waterX2 >= 4 and hunger < HUNGER_MAX then
        for _, b in ipairs(bubbles) do
            b.y = b.y - 1
            if b.y <= 0 then
                b.y = 6 + math.random(2)
                b.x = math.floor(fish.x + 0.5) + 2 + math.random(3)
            end
        end
    end

    -- 饲料：下沉、沉底消失（发酵污染，投喂时已计入废物）、被鱼追上吃掉
    for i = #feeds, 1, -1 do
        local f = feeds[i]
        f.y = f.y + 1
        if f.y >= 15 then
            table.remove(feeds, i)
        elseif math.abs(f.x - fish.x - 2) <= 2.5 and math.abs(f.y - fish.y - 5) <= 1.5 then
            table.remove(feeds, i)
            for _, b in ipairs(bubbles) do b.y = 1 end   -- 吃到后兴奋吐泡
        end
    end

    -- 饥饿：在场 +1/3 分钟；饿急了啃最矮的草（真实习性）
    if frame % HUNGER_FRAMES == 0 then
        if hunger < HUNGER_MAX then
            hunger = hunger + 1
        else
            -- 病危计时：在场也累计（每 3 分钟一格 ≈ 1 天 480 帧 → 用天换算近似）
        end
    end
    if hunger >= 5 and frame % 48 == 0 then
        local shortest = 1
        for i = 2, 3 do
            if sim.grass[i] < sim.grass[shortest] then shortest = i end
        end
        if sim.grass[shortest] > 1 then
            sim.grass[shortest] = sim.grass[shortest] - 1
            push_log("鱼饿急了，啃了最矮的水草")
            save_sim()
        end
    end

    -- 水草每日生长（在场自然生长；白天放氧）
    local d = day_of(t)
    if d ~= manual_day then
        manual_day = d
        manual_count = 0
        today_fed = 0
        save_feed()
        for i = 1, 3 do sim.grass[i] = math.min(GRASS_MAX, sim.grass[i] + 1) end
        if sim.waterX2 <= 2 and sim.algae < 4 then
            sim.algae = sim.algae + 1
            push_log("缸壁长出了新的藻")
        end
        if sim.waterX2 < WATER_X2_MAX and sim.snail_on == 1 then
            sim.waterX2 = sim.waterX2 + 1   -- 螺的清洁贡献
        end
        save_sim()
    end

    -- 螺爬行（很慢）
    if sim.snail_on == 1 and frame % 8 == 0 then
        sim.snail = sim.snail % COLS + 1
    end

    -- 年老判定（在场也生效）
    if age >= sim.lifespan then die("年老（享年 " .. age .. " 天）") end

    if matrix_frames > 0 then matrix_frames = matrix_frames - 1 end
end

local FISH_PIXELS = {
    ".......##..........", "......#######......", "##..###########....",
    "################...", ".############.###..", "################...",
    "##..###########....", "......#######......", "........##.........",
}
local fish_images = {}
local function draw_fish(x, y, scale, dir)
    local key = scale * dir
    if not fish_images[key] then
        local rows = {}
        local width = #FISH_PIXELS[1] * scale
        for _, line in ipairs(FISH_PIXELS) do
            if dir < 0 then line = line:reverse() end
            local row, byte, bits = {}, 0, 0
            for col = 1, width do
                local index = (col - 1) // scale + 1
                byte = byte * 2 + (line:sub(index, index) == "#" and 1 or 0)
                bits = bits + 1
                if bits == 8 then
                    row[#row + 1] = string.char(byte)
                    byte, bits = 0, 0
                end
            end
            if bits > 0 then row[#row + 1] = string.char(byte << (8 - bits)) end
            rows[#rows + 1] = string.rep(table.concat(row), scale)
        end
        fish_images[key] = string.format("P4\n%d %d\n", width, #FISH_PIXELS * scale)
            .. table.concat(rows)
    end
    ui.image(fish_images[key], x, y)
end

function on_key(action)
    if view == "reset_confirm" or view == "reset_error" then
        if view == "reset_confirm" and action == "voice_long" then
            store.set("reset_pending", "1")
            if store.get("reset_pending") == "1" then begin_reset()
            else view = "reset_error" end
        elseif action == "prev_long" then
            view = "settings"
        end
        return
    end
    if view == "matrix" then
        if action == "prev_long" then view = "menu" end
        return
    end
    if view == "report" then
        if action == "prev_long" then
            view = "tank"
            report_lines = {}
        end
        return
    end

    if view == "menu" then
        if action == "prev" then menu_index = (menu_index - 2) % #MENU + 1 end
        if action == "next" then menu_index = menu_index % #MENU + 1 end
        if action == "ok" then
            view = MENU[menu_index][2]
            if view == "log" then log_page, log_parent = 1, "menu" end
        end
        if action == "voice_long" then view, matrix_frames = "matrix", 20 end
        if action == "prev_long" then view = "tank" end
        return
    end

    if view == "settings" then
        if settings_index == 4 and action == "next_long" then
            view = "reset_confirm"
            return
        end
        if action == "prev" then settings_index = (settings_index - 2) % 4 + 1 end
        if action == "next" then settings_index = settings_index % 4 + 1 end
        if action == "ok" then
            if settings_index == 1 then
                breed_on = not breed_on
                store.set("breed", breed_on and "1" or "0")
                push_log("繁育已" .. (breed_on and "开启" or "关闭"))
            elseif settings_index == 2 then
                calm = not calm
                store.set("calm", calm and "1" or "0")
            elseif settings_index == 3 then
                if child then transfer_child() end
            end
        end
        if action == "prev_long" then view = "menu" end
        return
    end

    if view == "tank" then
        if action == "prev" then
            view, log_page, log_parent = "log", 1, "tank"
        elseif action == "next" then
            return
        elseif action == "next_long" then
            view = "menu"
        elseif action == "prev_long" then
            flush_store(2, true)
            if ble.scan_active() then ble.scan_stop() end
            if ble.adv_active() then ble.adv_stop() end
            sys.exit()
        elseif action == "ok" then
            if sim.dead == 1 then
                hatch_next_gen()
            elseif manual_count >= MANUAL_DAILY then
                push_log("鱼摇了摇头（今日撒食已达上限）")
            else
                manual_count = manual_count + 1
                save_feed()
                feed("*")
                push_log("主人手动撒食 " .. manual_count .. "/" .. MANUAL_DAILY)
            end
        elseif action == "voice_long" then
            -- 长按语音键换水：水质回满、藻清除、螺留下（真实养鱼的核心操作）
            if sim.dead ~= 1 then
                sim.waterX2 = WATER_X2_MAX
                sim.algae = 0
                push_log("主人换了水，水质恢复")
                save_sim()
            end
        end
        flush_store(4, true)   -- 手动操作优先提交鱼塘和投喂状态
        return
    end
    if view == "log" and (action == "prev" or action == "next") then
        log_page = math.max(1, math.min(log_pages, log_page + (action == "prev" and -1 or 1)))
        return
    end
    if view == "stats" and action == "next_long" then
        transfer_child()
        view = "settings"
    elseif action == "prev_long" then
        view = view == "log" and log_parent or "menu"
    end
end

-- ---------- 帧循环 ----------
function on_idle()
    if frame % 12 == 0 and not ble.scan_active() and ble.running() then ble.scan_start() end
    handle_scan()
    step()
    advertise()
    -- 转移超时：子女留在缸中（宁可保留也不丢数据），仅结束转移模式
    if transfer_until > 0 and wall_time() > transfer_until and child ~= nil then
        transfer_until = 0
        push_log("转移超时，子女留在缸中")
    end
    if view == "matrix" then
        if matrix_frames <= 0 then view = "menu" end
        return true
    end
    -- last_seen 每 60 帧（约 40 秒）刷新一次：退出后推演起点误差可忽略
    -- （3.4 起并入 sim 序列化，随限流 flush 落盘，不再单独 store.set）
    if frame % 60 == 0 then sim.last_seen = wall_time(); save_sim() end
    -- 兜底落盘：不在扫描中的路径（手动喂食/繁育/换水等）产生的脏数据也周期写回；
    -- 每轮最多写 1 个 key，剩余脏项下一轮继续（单回调写盘限流）
    if frame % 3 == 0 then flush_store(1) end
    -- 物理和协议照常推进，静态页面等按键，鱼塘只在渲染节拍提交画面。
    local render_every = (calm or not awake or sim.dead == 1) and 6 or 3
    return view == "tank" and frame % render_every == 0
end

-- 顶层：推演 → 广播 → 首帧
local now = wall_time()
offline_tick(now)    -- 先用旧 last_seen 推演，再更新基准（顺序颠倒会让 delta 恒为 0）
sim.last_seen = now
save_sim()           -- last_seen 每次启动必落盘（推演基准，不能依赖推演是否产生脏数据）
flush_store(2)   -- 离线推演改出的状态立即落盘；顶层一次回调限写 2 个 key，剩余项由 on_idle 逐帧消化
if not ble.scan_start() then
    if ble.running() then push_log("扫描启动失败，将随帧重试") end
end
advertise()
draw()
flush_store(2)   -- 首帧渲染期间（推演报告/日切）产生的写盘收尾
end
